name: R003-rapidash-bounce-hail
why: Challenge 7 (full AI). The opponent leads Rapidash (set 515: Fire Blast, Bounce, Double Team, Attract). The player leads Walrein (set 452) and uses Hail on turn 1 (Thick Fat halves Fire Blast). From the next AI turn, while Hail is up, the AI scores Bounce through AI_CV_SemiInvulnerable: the player has never used Protect (Walrein never uses slot 3 in the script), is not toxic / cursed / seeded, and get_weather writes Hail, so the non-BUGFIX Hail branch (to CheckSandstormTypes) runs: the runCvSemiInvulnerable Hail block. Walrein keeps using Hail (it fails while Hail is up and renews it when it ends). A turn after Rapidash's Bounce is a locked turn (no AI choice), so the code runs on the other turns.
